featured_reviews.name: Sameer Ghadi
featured_reviews.review_text:
5/5 Stars – Perfect Maharashtrian Catering for Ganesh Jayanti Feast!
We ordered from Santosh Catering for Ganesh Jayanti on 22-01-2026, and it was flawless! Parcel service for lunch (30 people) and dinner (50 people) – both deliveries were super smooth and right on time.
Lunch Menu (30 pax): Paneer Lazeez, Sukha Batata Bhaji, Chapati (3 per person), Jeera Rice, Dal Fry, Koshimbir, Papad, Achar. Every item was delicious, fresh, and packed with authentic Maharashtrian flavors – the Paneer Lazeez was a highlight! Best part: completely soda-free (no baking soda powder), so all tastes were pure and natural.
Dinner Menu (50 pax): Veg Kolhapuri, Bhendi Masala, Chapati (3 per person), Jeera Rice, Dal Fry, Koshimbir, Papad, Achar. The Veg Kolhapuri had the perfect spicy kick, and portions were generous for our big group – again, soda-free for genuine flavors.
Prices are very reasonable for the quality and variety, making it ideal for celebrations. Highly recommend – Santosh Catering nailed it!

featured_reviews.name: Raviraj Samant
featured_reviews.review_text:
Positives:
1. The food taste was good.
2. The decoration was nice.

Negatives:
1. The manager literally coerced me to give a 5 star review. Well! You better give me a good service for that but HELL NO! THEY DIDN'T!
2. The servers with starters just did NOT come to the row where we were seated, which was RIGHT NEXT to where they were entering from.
3. I told the manager herself, and the other boy who was sub-manager, not once or twice but multiple times, and even then they didn't give us starters even 1 damn time!
4. I agree, we were here for the function and not just for the food. But if you are behind my back for a review, might as well provide a good service.

So overall, I really would not recommend their services. I'm sorry, if you check my other reviews I am mostly very considerate.

But these guys just didn't listen to my request at all. They just kept on bringing water and juice. What do you want me to do? Overdose on liquids and keep peeing?

Also there were barely any chairs for us to have lunch. And I had to keep my plate next to the person who was collecting used plates. Nice!

So my sincere request to them is that please instruct your robotic like serving staff to apply some brains as to where to serve next instead of going to the same place like ants. While I agree that every profession should be respected but then do it properly and not for the sake of it or atleast your manager should observe it.

1 star is for their taste of food and the other is for the decoration. That's it. You asked me how were the starters without even serving me and gave me 1 paneer tikka to review and never to come back again. 😂 Hilarious!

We hired JK Caterers for seven days for my sister’s wedding, and honestly, those seven days felt nothing less than a beautiful family experience. They didn’t serve us like caterers they cared for us like their own. Every meal felt like it was prepared with love, and there was never a moment when it felt commercial. It truly felt like home.

I especially want to appreciate their hygiene and food quality. In today’s time, it’s rare to find caterers who don’t compromise on these things, but JK Caterers set a completely different standard. Every dish was A1 quality, fresh, clean, and full of flavour. Their chef can prepare any state’s cuisine so authentically that you instantly feel transported to that place.

But what touched our hearts the most was their warmth and homely behaviour. Their entire team treated our guests and family with such respect and affection that it felt like they were members of our own family. Their presence added comfort, joy, and ease to our celebrations.

There is so much I could say, but even words fall short. My heartfelt gratitude to Jaydev Bhai, Pandey Bhai, and the entire JK Caterers team for feeding us with such love and making our special days truly unforgettable. I pray and hope that they continue to be a part of all our future celebrations, just like family.

featured_reviews.name: Harsh Bhagtani
featured_reviews.review_text:
We love Parsi food and when we get it delivered at home, we love it more. I ordered a dhansak which was very well balanced dish and came with brown rice and salad. Brown rice was perfect and long. The dhansak was flavourful. I also ordered the Chicken Farcha which was a bit oily but it was yummy. The Lagan nu Custard was delivered frozen cold maintaining it's texture and temperature and tasted the best out of all the dishes. Also tried their chicken croissant🥐 which was soft and the filling was pretty decent.
Must try for Parsi food Lovers. Homely feeling in the taste

featured_reviews.name: Rustom Irani
featured_reviews.review_text:
There's food which comforts and food that helps you escape by triggering the taste buds of memory or location. Very rarely do you get to experience food that does both.
'Cheron' have kept a small yet bright flicker of Parsi food alive amidst a whole bunch of new agey franchisee places.
The chutney is the stuff of legend. It's what makes every amazing Patra ni Machhi you have tried a food of the gods. And if you haven't tried this chutney in its other avatars in a patty or as a sandwich you have denied yourself a pleasured palate.
I'm a big kebabs and appetizer meats guy, so immediately took a liking to the delicately spiced chicken cheese balls and the smokey melt-in-your-mouth tikkas.
The chicken mince balls were a big sense and slightly spicidr so i suggest have them piping hit as juices might dry up of you pack then too long.
The kheema patty's/chops are mini meals in themselves so less is more is a great idea.
Overall though for the price and the taste alone make them a regular snacking option if not a complete Sunday meal with the family.
Go ahead prepare to escape in food heaven.

Malai tikka croissants

Must try desserts:-

Cheron has so many variety of food items that you'll definitely get confused when you'll visit it first time, but that's the point -- visit it first time then it will make you visit again and again to taste every item of their menu. All the best for your wallet.

It's is place where you'll get Quantity as well as Quality.

featured_reviews.review_text:
To the Incredible Team of Gurukrupa Caterers.
Dear Vishal Bhai,
I wanted to send a sincere thank you for the exceptional service and soul-warming food you provided for our Vanage family wedding.
In the lead-up to the big day, my biggest wish was that our guests wouldn't just "eat," but that they would feel the same love and comfort they do when dining a grand feast at home. You delivered on that wish and did beyond our expectations.
Why Your Service Was Exceptional:
The "Home-Cooked" Touch: It is rare to find catering on such a large scale that maintains the authentic, rich flavors of a family kitchen. Every dish tasted like it was prepared with personal care rather than in a commercial cuisine.
Warmth in Service: Your staff didn't just serve plates; they hosted our guests with a level of hospitality that felt genuinely personal and kind.
Attention to Detail: From the temperature of the appetizers to the presentation of the main course, everything was handled with absolute precision.
Speed of service: The staff was on toes to ensure that long waiting queues of guests will not form at any counter.
Many of our relatives mentioned that the meal was the highlight of the function, reminding them of the best family gatherings we’ve had over the years. You helped make the most important day of our life feel intimate, cozy, and delicious.
Thank you for putting your heart into your services. We look forward to working with you again for future family milestones!
With gratitude,
Pravin Vanage

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Bhosle
featured_reviews.review_text:
We also hired Green Leaf Food as the caterers for our destination wedding, and they did an excellent job across all events. The food quality, taste, and presentation were outstanding and received great appreciation from all our guests.

They catered for our 3-day wedding celebrations, including Mehendi, Haldi, Sangeet, Engagement, Wedding, Varmala, and Reception, and managed everything very smoothly. The menu variety was well planned, hygiene standards were maintained, and service was timely and well-organized.

A special thanks to Gaurab Sir, who managed the entire catering planning professionally and ensured all arrangements were perfectly executed. Also, Sunil Sir, who handled the on-event coordination, did a great job managing the team and service flow during all functions.

Overall, Green Leaf Food delivered a wonderful catering experience and played a big role in making our destination wedding memorable. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality food and professional catering services.
